content.text:
**2 medicines from abroad — what each is in the US**
1. **Nurofen** (RU, UA)
   Nurofen contains ibuprofen. In the US the same active ingredient is sold as ibuprofen (brands: Advil, Motrin); ask the pharmacist for it by that name.
   Atorvastatin Calcium — slug atorvastatin-calcium — with the card from $9.40, observed 2026-09-21
2. **No-Spa** (RU, PL)
   No-Spa (drotaverine) is not sold in the US. Ask a US clinician about the options for your symptoms.
Same active ingredient does not mean the same product: strength, form and excipients can differ. Confirm with a pharmacist. Not medical advice.
1 of the names matched no reviewed brand and were left out — do not guess what they are; ask for the active ingredient.

Next (calls that fit this answer, arguments filled in from it):

- get_savings_card(drug="atorvastatin-calcium") — The card, for when a US prescriber has written the prescription.

**Free FineRx card:** BIN 610219 · PCN DRX · Group MYCARD3993
Use the free FineRx card — accepted at 34+ pharmacy chains, no signup. Save it, print it, email or text it. Savings with the card can be substantial — estimated prices are on our site. Show the card at the pharmacy to get the final price.
_Not insurance · prices observed 2026-09-20 · FineRx may earn a fee · not medical advice_
